scope: Bindings v7: ordinary runs around protected native fields, line breaks and paragraph separators in shapes and tables

implementation.reuse: One native paragraph slot parser/matcher replaces duplicated shape and table-cell parsing
implementation.editable: Existing ordinary a:r/a:t slots only; exact position/count matching, not value-based native lookup
implementation.protected: Field ID/type/cache/style, line break rPr/topology, paragraph separators and package payloads remain protected by native slots and official Model digest
implementation.empty_cache: Empty a:fld creates no Model run and remains native opaque content
implementation.diagnostics: Located pptx.field / cached-field-text record explicitly marks cached-only projection as opaque
implementation.compatibility: v1-v6 retain original scopes; structured slots enabled only in v7
implementation.atomicity: Unknown children and protected edits refuse; cancellation preserves source, Model and existing destination

checks.regression_command: python -m pytest tests/readers tests/writers tests/support/test_ooxml_pptx_package.py tests/support/test_ooxml_package.py -k 'pptx or office_export_cancellation or ooxml_package' -q --tb=short
checks.release_archives: 0.42.0 wheel/sdist, licenses, metadata, resources and required modules verified

installed_pptx_only_smoke.scope: Two JSON cycles; text around field/break in shape and table alongside native frames/grid/crop; protected field/break XML exact and all other payloads unchanged
installed_pptx_only_smoke.inventory_scope: Reviewed uv.lock unchanged; smoke additionally resolves xlsxwriter 3.3.1, lock pins 3.3.0

native_acceptance.ownership: Read-only source, macros disabled, fresh owned COM app only; only owned decks and RCWs closed, own process exit awaited

limits: No field creation, editing or evaluation in Model; cached text is not a semantic field DTO
No line-break/paragraph topology editing or arbitrary run insertion/removal
Unsupported native inline children remain outside editable text profile
Finite source acceptance on own slidenum field; not all field/rendering/layout profiles
No full general PPTX fidelity, ZIP metadata or signature editing claim
